note: Submodule of custom_field. Provides one custom_field_widget plugin, entity_reference_entity_browser (class EntityReferenceBrowserWidget), for the parent's entity_reference subfield type; hardcoded cardinality 1. Its per-column settings live on the Custom Field's base-widget form-display component at settings.fields.<col> and include type (the widget id), entity_browser (the Entity Browser instance id), field_widget_display (default 'label'), field_widget_display_settings, open, field_widget_edit/remove/replace (added to custom_field.field.* schema by hook_config_schema_info_alter in ConfigSchemaHooks). No config entity/route/permission/drush. Medium/hard cases build a Custom Field with an entity_reference column (target_type node) on a namespaced content type cfeb_eval (field field_cfeb_ref) and read/set the per-column widget on the live form display; setup/reset/cleanup create then remove the field and content type so nothing else is touched.

evals.prompt: In the custom_field_entity_browser submodule, what is the machine name of the widget it adds, and which Custom Field subfield (column) type can use it?
evals.expected_output: It adds the custom_field_widget plugin `entity_reference_entity_browser` (class EntityReferenceBrowserWidget), usable on a Custom Field column of subfield type `entity_reference`.

evals.prompt: When you use the Entity Browser widget on a Custom Field entity_reference column, which setting picks the Entity Browser instance to open, and which setting controls how selected entities are displayed?
evals.expected_output: `entity_browser` names the Entity Browser instance to open; `field_widget_display` (default `label`) controls how selected entities are shown, with `field_widget_display_settings` for that display plugin. These are added to the custom_field.field.* schema.

evals.prompt: Where is the choice of the Entity Browser widget stored for a Custom Field column, and is the widget multi-value?
evals.expected_output: It is stored on the Custom Field's base-widget component in the form display at settings.fields.<column>.type = entity_reference_entity_browser. The widget is hardcoded to cardinality 1 (single referenced entity per item).

evals.prompt: On this site the 'cfeb_eval' content type has a Custom Field field_cfeb_ref with an entity_reference column named 'ref'. Inspect the live default form display and state which widget is configured for that column.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.cfeb_eval.default the field_cfeb_ref component has settings.fields.ref.type = entity_reference_entity_browser.

evals.prompt: The Entity Browser widget on field_cfeb_ref's 'ref' column (content type cfeb_eval) is configured with a particular 'field widget display'. Inspect the live form display and report its value.

On this site, the Custom Field field_cfeb_ref on content type 'cfeb_eval' has an entity_reference column 'ref' currently edited with the plain autocomplete widget. Using custom_field_entity_browser, reconfigure the default form display so that the 'ref' column uses the Entity Browser widget instead. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.cfeb_eval.default the field_cfeb_ref component has settings.fields.ref.type = entity_reference_entity_browser.

evals.prompt: On content type 'cfeb_eval', create a Custom Field named field_cfeb_ref whose storage defines a single entity_reference column named 'ref' that references node entities (target_type node). Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: field.storage.node.field_cfeb_ref is a `custom` field whose settings.columns.ref has type entity_reference and target_type node, instanced on cfeb_eval.
